entry.title: In SAP-Query (SQ00) funktioniert nach S4-Migration die Berichtsschnittstelle nicht mehr
entry.content: Es exisiert in SAP-Query eine Auswerung zu Anlagen (ANLA, ANLZ), die Ausgabe enthält neben weiteren Feldern auch den Buchungskreis Bukrs, die Anlagenhauptnummer ANLN1 und die Anlagenunternummer ANLN2. Über die Berichtszuordnung des Queries ist doe TA AS03 zugeordnet. Bei Doppelklick auf eine Listzeile wird die TA AS03 gestartet, aber nicht mehr die Werte o.g. 3 Felder - Felder sind leer. Vor S4-Migration wurden die Feldinhalte der Listzeile übergeben und die TA AS03 zur Anzeige der Anlage gebracht. Diese Erscheinung tritt auch im Entwicklungssystem TP1 auf.

entry.title: Unwanted Foreign trade data number while Credit memo creation
entry.content:
• I am facing an issue where a Foreign Trade Data Number (vbrk-exnum) is unexpectedly generated during the creation of an order-related Credit Memo (referenced from a Credit Memo without quantity request).

  • The transaction is purely domestic, with the physical Departure and Destination countries being exactly the same.

  • Master data checks via KNA1 confirm that the assigned countries for the Sold-To, Ship-To, and Payer partners all match this single country.

  • In the Copy Control (VTFA) configuration, the header setting for Determ.export data is set to 'B' (Redetermine export data).

  • I have checked tables EIKP, LIKP, VBRK, and VBRP and verified that previous documents in this specific flow, such as the Delivery and Invoice, did not have a Foreign Trade Data Number generated.

  • Crucially, the Export Indicator (EXPKZ) is completely blank for all documents across the entire document flow.

  • Because EXPKZ is blank, standard SAP logic (FORM EXPORT_DATEN_ERMITTELN) should normally bypass the generation of foreign trade data.

  • We are looking to find out if there are any standard user exits, BAdIs, or inherent copy control behaviors (specifically related to Determ.export data = 'B') that would interfere here and force the EXNUM generation despite the domestic setup and blank indicator.

    Please help me find some solution to this

entry.title: 固定资产贷方记账核减资产原值报错
entry.content: 你好，尊敬的专家！在进行固定资产的贷方记账，核减资产原值的时候，如果不勾选资产主数据中的“允许负值”按钮，通常会报错：行项目导致了将违反的 -118.33 的残值-118.33140000005582-0000！然而经过检查，固定资产的净值是远大于我们核减的金额的，并不会让资产的价值变成负数。比如上面我举例的这个报错消息，金额是118.33，这个是由于我核减的金额是2366.52，资产的残值率是0.05，所以得出了这个金额。请尊敬的专家帮忙解析一下SAP的计算逻辑，非常感谢！

entry.title: In-Process Inspection: Usage Decision Completed Without Results Recording
entry.content:
HI

In the In-Process Inspection setup, I have maintained the required QM master data and configured OPK4 with the setting "Error message if no inspection results exist."

When I create and release a production order, the inspection lot is generated automatically as expected.

Since OPK4 is configured with an error message, I am unable to perform the production order confirmation until the inspection lot has been processed and inspection results have been recorded.

However, I noticed that SAP still allows me to perform the Usage Decision (UD) on the inspection lot without recording any inspection results.

The inspection lot status is  UD done, but because no results were recorded, the production order confirmation is still blocked by the OPK4 error check.

Now how to proceed to confirm the prod order. Can we reverse the UD ?if yes how to do?
Can we restrict to not to do UD before results recording incase of Inspection type 03?

entry.title: Replace FIFO-assigned batches in outbound delivery (batch split items) via BAPI – VLBAPI 004 / /SPE/
entry.content:
Goal
I create an outbound delivery with BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CREATE_SLS (via UiPath/NCo). Batch determination assigns batches by FIFO, which creates batch split sub-items (9000xx) under the parent items (parent LFIMG = 0, batch in the child). I then need to replace these batches with specific batches (serial numbers = CHARG) that were scanned on a check sheet. I must not post goods issue.

What works manually
In VL02N, on the item overview, I can either overwrite the batch on the batch split item, or add a new batch split item with the desired batch and delete the old one. Both save without errors.

What I tried with BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CHANGE

  1. Changing BATCH on the child item (ITEM_DATA + ITEM_CONTROL😞 VLBAPI 004 – “Error in document &1 item &2 (quantity consistency check)”.
  2. Deleting the old child item and adding a new one (ITEM_DATA with HIERARITEM = parent, USEHIERITM = ‘1’, MATERIAL, BATCH, DLV_QTY; ITEM_ORG with PLANT/STGE_LOC; ITEM_CONTROL-CHG_DELQTY = ‘X’): /SPE/DIRDLV 006 when STGE_LOC is not given, and /SPE/DIRDLV 014 (“no warehouse number for 1000/IFGL”) when it is given.
  3. Add first, then delete: same errors. In one run the delete was committed before the add failed, which left a parent item with no child item.

The BAPI return table is checked, and BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK is called on error.

System info

  • QAS system, plant 1000, storage location IFGL (this storage location does not belong to a warehouse number).
  • Stock comes from MCHB (CLABS > 0), batches are managed per material.

Questions

  1. Is there a supported way to change or replace the batch of a batch split item in an existing delivery from a program (without GUI automation)? For example WS_DELIVERY_UPDATE_2 with VBPOK_TAB / VBKOK_WA, or BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CHANGE with specific fields that I missed?
  2. Why do the /SPE/DIRDLV checks (006, 014) run for a storage location that has no warehouse number? Is there a configuration or BAdI that causes them, and does it affect only the BAPI path and not VL02N?
  3. Is it possible to pass the desired batch at creation time, so that FIFO determination is skipped (for example by giving the batch split items directly in BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CREATE_SLS)?

I can provide the exact BAPI input/return tables if needed. Thank you!

entry.title: Umstellung auf pain001.001.09- Message Type
entry.content:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

wir haben das SEPA Format für unsere Gehaltsdateien auf pain 001.001.09 umgestellt und testen zur Zeit den Austausch bzw. Versendung zur Bank.

Wir versenden über PI die verschlüsselte Datei an das System der Bank.

Die Tests bzw. die Dateien sind ok .

Die Bank fordert uns aber auf, einen anderen Message Type zu senden. Im Standard ist es Message Type pain 001.001.09. 

Die Bank möchte aber, dass wir den Message Type pain 001.001.09hr übermitteln.

Können Sie uns mitteilen, wo der Message Type von uns im SAP System hinterlegt werden kann. In den Transaktionen OBPM1 und DMEE habe ich dazu leider nichts gefunden bzw. bin mir unsicher welche Auswirkungen es geben wird.

Vielen Dank für Ihre Unterstützung.

Viele Grüße,

Carola Bogedain

entry.title: Historical Reporting for Processed Customer Payment Advice apart from FBL5N
entry.content:
Currently, once a Customer Payment Advice (CPA) is successfully posted, standard SAP removes it from the posting screen. As a result, the posted advice cannot be viewed or reviewed if issues arise with customer payments

FBL5N only shows accounting lines and does not provide the full remittance detail (e.g., customer deduction reasons, payer reference numbers, and original line-by-line breakdown).

We need to confirm whether an SAP standard transaction or note exists to retain and report on posted payment advice, or if we should provide a custom report/query based on our staging table.

entry.title: Planned depreciation not calculated/recorded when periodic share is less than € 0.01
entry.content:
Dear SAP,

We have a problem with some assets with very low residual book value, they are not receiving the ordinary depreciation allowance, even if their useful life has not yet expired. The problem concerns:
useful-life depreciated assets (e.g. WEET depreciation key);
percentage-amortized assets (e.g. WE3B amortization key).
Due to the very low value, the depreciation share of the period is less than € 0.01.

For this reason, the system does not calculate or record any amount.

As a result, the tuft remains with a residual value that does not reach zero by the end of the planned useful life.
We have verified the OAYO transaction and it solves the cent case but it also incorrectly rounds the values of tufts not in scope
Are there any SAP notes or standard fixes applicable to our release (S4/HANA) to handle this case?

thanks

best regards

Giuseppe

entry.title: Request SAP clarification on the standard date determination logic used by program RVV50R10C
entry.content:
As part of enhancement ENHC0170076 analysis, testing was performed in the SE2 system using ZSTD Standing Orders with multiple schedule lines, delivery dates, and route schedules. The historical process uses SAP standard program RVV50R10C with variant ZMDDLJOB_STFRI, where the Delivery Creation Date is maintained dynamically (Current Date +0 through Current Date +3).

During testing, it was observed that delivery selection does not appear to be driven solely by the Confirmed Delivery Date. In several scenarios, the date considered by the delivery due list process aligned with the First Delivery Date generated during schedule-line processing. This behavior may explain business observations where deliveries considered as Tuesday deliveries were becoming eligible during Friday execution and were subsequently processed earlier than expected.

Request SAP clarification on the standard behavior of RVV50R10C, specifically:
- Which date field is used for delivery eligibility determination.
- Whether the program evaluates Confirmed Delivery Date, First Delivery Date, Material Availability Date, Transportation Planning Date, Goods Issue Date, or another schedule-line date.
